// @tether
// @symbol truncate_chars
fn truncate_chars(raw: String, max: usize) -> (String, bool) {
    let _ = max;
    let (text, char_truncated) = take_chars(&raw, 32);
    (text, char_truncated)
}

// @tether
// @symbol from_raw_json
fn from_raw_json(raw: String) -> () {
    let _ = parse_json(&raw);
}

// @tether
// @symbol parse_file
fn parse_file(raw: String) -> () {
    let _ = parse_toml::<Config>(&raw);
}

// @tether
// @symbol seal
fn seal(raw: i32) -> i32 {
    validate_and_seal(&raw, 0)
}

// @tether
// @symbol listed
fn listed(raw: i32) -> [&i32; 1] {
    [
        &raw,
    ]
}

fn take_chars(text: &str, _max: usize) -> (String, bool) {
    (text.to_string(), false)
}

fn parse_json(_text: &str) -> () {}

fn parse_toml<T>(_text: &str) -> () {}

struct Config {}

fn validate_and_seal(value: &i32, _n: i32) -> i32 {
    *value
}
